blocks.text: The Signature 360 Wellness & Emotional Wellbeing Retreat is a holistic, all inclusive wellness retreat experience designed to help you rest deeply, reset your health, restore mentally and emotionally and reconnect with balance. Set within luxury beachfront wellness resorts in Bali and Mexico, this retreat brings together daily wellness experiences, nourishing detox cuisine, spa, fitness and movement, yoga and meditation, mindfulness, healing therapies and space simply to slow down.

This life changing retreat experience gives you access to the full Alive team and the powerful Alive Process workshops and masterclasses. A unique process built to de stress your body, mind and life in record time.

During your stay, you are free to personalise your experience based on how you want to feel. Some guests focus on rest, relaxation and daily wellness classes. Others choose to add detox and cleanse support, health treatment and longevity sessions, fitness, weight management, emotional wellbeing or deeper healing therapies through the wellness clinic.

Supported by experienced wellness professionals across health, movement, mindfulness, emotional healing and holistic care, the Signature 360 retreat offers more than a traditional wellness resort stay. It is a complete wellness retreat experience that supports your body, mind and lifestyle, without pressure, doing as much or as little as you like.

At Alive, wellness is not just about feeling better, it is about a enjoying a deeply restorative truly holistic wellness retreat that leaves you and your life transformed. You leave rested, nourished and clearer, with healthier habits, renewed energy and a sense of calm that carries well beyond your stay.

Is This The Wellness Experience You've Been Looking For?
Rest, Calm, Restore & Invigorate = A New You.

Imagine arriving at a luxury beachfront wellness retreat where everything is taken care of for you. Your accommodation, meals, wellness experiences, spa access and daily classes are all included, leaving you free to slow down, choose what you need each day and simply feel supported.
At Alive, you receive:
✔️ A body that feels stronger, lighter and invigorated Through daily movement, yoga, fitness and restorative practices you can join as gently or actively as you choose
✔️ Deep rest, calm and mental clarity With meditation, healing and relaxation classes, spa time and space to truly switch off
✔️ Nourishment that supports real health and energy All-inclusive whole food cleanse cuisine, with the option of cleanse or detox menus tailored to your needs

✔️ The freedom to choose your wellness experience Join daily classes, enjoy spa and massage, rest by the pool or add personalised health, life coaching, personal healing, longevity and biohacking sessions only if you wish

This is a luxury wellness retreat where you are not pushed, fixed or rushed. You are supported, cared for and given the space to feel like yourself again with the ability to customise a life changing retreat experience.

blocks.text: The Alive Wellness Hub & Spa is where wellness becomes part of everyday life. Just steps from the resort, this beautifully designed space offers a full daily program of movement, mindfulness, recovery and restoration, all included in your stay and available as you choose.

Your days are supported by a rich schedule of expertly led classes and experiences. Join what feels right, when it feels right. There is no pressure to do it all. Wellness here is generous, flexible and always accessible.

From energising movement and calming practices to recovery and indulgent spa rituals, the Wellness Hub allows you to care for your body and mind in a way that feels natural, enjoyable and deeply supportive.

Private Wellness Therapies & Longevity Clinic
Private one on one therapies for physical, mental, emotional and life transformation

For those who want to go deeper, Alive offers a wide range of private wellness therapies and one-on-one sessions, delivered by highly skilled, hand-picked professionals. These sessions allow you to focus on what you need most, with personalised support that meets you where you are.

All therapies are optional and can be added to your stay at any time. Some guests choose one or two sessions. Others build a more immersive, customised wellness experience. There is no expectation to do it all. You simply choose what feels right for you.
This is where wellness becomes personal, refined and deeply supportive.
